description.fun: Emolga glides from treetop to treetop on a cape-like membrane, crackling with electricity made in its cheek pouches. The sparks keep bird Pokémon away, so it gets to keep all its food to itself, and it grills berries and bug Pokémon with electric shocks before eating them. It loves sweet berries so much that it sometimes stuffs its cheeks too full to fly. Cute, but a lot of trouble.
description.guide: Emolga is an Electric- and Flying-type flying squirrel Pokémon that glides on a cape-like membrane while releasing electricity stored in its cheeks. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A flying squirrel that glides on a cape and zaps its dinner.
